en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a grand neoclassical building beside a water feature in a park. The façade has large windows framed by full-height statues and rich stone decoration, with a balustraded roofline topped by sculptures. In front, a rounded terrace or pavilion with a striped awning projects over a pond or canal; its rusticated base has round porthole-like windows and ornamental reliefs. A small fountain or water outlet with sculptural decoration pours water into the pond. Trees and a path with low railings fill the foreground, and additional historic city buildings appear in the distance.
